identity.name: Forma Intime
identity.tagline: Engineered for the body. Worn by the self.
identity.one_line_description: Forma Intime is a precision lingerie brand that applies clinical rigor and material science to intimate apparel, creating pieces designed for real anatomy, daily comfort, and lasting integrity.
identity.target_audience: Discerning women aged 28–45 who prioritize comfort, construction quality, and body-positive design over trend-driven aesthetics — shoppers who read ingredient labels and care about what touches their skin.

sections.headline: Three principles. No compromises.

items.title: Anatomical Construction
items.description: Each pattern is drafted against a library of 12 body profiles, not a single standard size. Seams follow the body's natural lines — never across pressure points.

items.title: Material Integrity
items.description: We source only certified, traceable fabrics: medical-grade modal, Tencel blends, and recycled nylon with verified colorfastness. What touches your skin is documented.

items.title: Longevity Protocol
items.description: Every garment is stress-tested for 200 wash cycles before release. We publish the results. Forma Intime pieces are designed to outlast fast fashion by years.

pages.title: Materials
pages.goal: Build deep trust with the ingredient-conscious visitor by presenting Forma Intime's material sourcing, certification standards, and textile science as a transparent, documented system — the way a clinical brand presents its formulation data.
pages.meta_description: Forma Intime uses only OEKO-TEX certified, traceable fabrics. Learn about our medical-grade modal, recycled nylon, and TENCEL sourcing — and why it matters for skin health.

sections.intent: Set a deliberate, authoritative tone for the materials story — signal to the visitor that this page contains real information, not marketing language.
sections.headline: What we use. Why it matters. Where it comes from.
sections.subheadline: Every Forma Intime fabric is selected against a clinical brief: skin compatibility, structural integrity, environmental traceability, and wash longevity.

sections.intent: Slow, deliberate stillness — tell the origin story of Forma Intime's material philosophy in editorial prose, establishing the brand's commitment to transparency as a founding principle, not a marketing add-on.
sections.headline: We started with a question dermatologists ask.
sections.body: When Forma Intime was founded, the first question our design team asked wasn't 'what looks beautiful?' — it was 'what is safe to wear against the skin for 16 hours a day?' That question led us to dermatology literature, textile toxicology studies, and conversations with fabric mills that most fashion brands never have. Our material brief is a living document. Every fabric we use must pass four tests: OEKO-TEX Standard 100 certification, verified colorfastness at 60°C, elastic retention after 200 wash cycles, and documented supply chain traceability to the fiber source. If a fabric fails any one of these, it doesn't enter our range.

sections.intent: Present each core material as a structured data card — clinical, informative, precise. The visitor should feel like they are reading a well-organized reference document, not a fabric marketing page.
sections.headline: Four materials. Documented from fiber to finish.

items.title: Medical-Grade Modal
items.description: Derived from sustainably harvested beech wood. Softer than cotton, with a documented pH-neutral finish. Used in Forma Soft and Forma Night. OEKO-TEX Standard 100 certified. Hypoallergenic — suitable for sensitive and post-surgical skin.

items.title: Recycled Nylon (Econyl®)
items.description: Regenerated from ocean-recovered fishing nets and industrial nylon waste. Maintains the same tensile strength and elastic recovery as virgin nylon. Used in Forma Structure and Forma Sport. GRS certified.

items.title: TENCEL™ Lyocell
items.description: Closed-loop solvent production — 99% of processing chemicals are recovered and reused. Moisture-wicking, temperature-regulating, and biodegradable. Used in Forma Base. Certified by the Lenzing Group.

items.title: Linen-Modal Blend
items.description: A proprietary blend developed with our Austrian mill partner. Linen's natural thermoregulation combined with modal's softness. Zero synthetic finish treatments. Used exclusively in Forma Night.

pages.title: Campaign
pages.goal: Bridge the clinical precision of the brand with its emotional and human dimension — show the campaign story as a documented creative process, letting the visitor see the thinking behind the imagery, the casting choices, and the fit sessions that produced the current collection.
pages.meta_description: The Forma Intime campaign — behind the process, the fit sessions, and the women who shaped this collection. Precision has a human side.

sections.intent: Arrive with quiet force — the campaign hero should feel like opening a clinical case study that turns out to be unexpectedly intimate. A single powerful statement that reframes what a lingerie campaign can say.
sections.headline: Intimacy is a form of precision.
sections.subheadline: This season's collection was built in collaboration with 40 women across 12 body profiles. This is their fit story.

sections.intent: Slow, editorial unfolding — tell the process story of how this campaign was made, grounding the creative work in the same methodical rigor as the material sourcing. The visitor should feel the brand's consistency of character.
sections.headline: We started with fit sessions, not mood boards.
sections.body: For the current campaign, we invited 40 women to our fit studio over six weeks — not models, but women who wear Forma Intime daily. Each session began with a body mapping consultation: posture, movement range, pressure-point documentation. The garments were adjusted in real time. What you see in the campaign is the result of those sessions — not a styled interpretation of them. The lighting is clinical. The framing is direct. The women are wearing pieces that were fitted to their specific anatomy. We believe that is the most honest thing a lingerie brand can show.

sections.intent: Present the campaign's featured pieces as a structured editorial grid — each item documented with the fit story behind it, creating a dashboard of precision and humanity together.
sections.headline: Six styles. Forty women. One brief.

items.title: Forma Soft in Chalk
items.description: Worn by nine participants across three body profiles. The most-adjusted piece in the fit sessions — shoulder strap geometry was revised twice based on real session data.

items.title: Forma Structure in Bone
items.description: The campaign's most technically complex piece. Wire placement was confirmed against ultrasound breast tissue mapping data for four participants with asymmetrical profiles.

items.title: Forma Base in Ecru
items.description: The most-worn piece across all 40 participants during the comfort endurance phase — worn for a full 12-hour session to document pressure-point data.

items.title: Forma Night in Linen-Chalk
items.description: Sleep-tested by eight participants over two weeks. Temperature regulation and sleep quality data informed the final linen-to-modal ratio.

sections.intent: A slow ambient warmth that invites lingering — let the women from the fit sessions speak in their own words, grounding the clinical brand story in lived, personal experience.
sections.headline: What precision feels like.

items.title: Maren, 34 — Forma Structure participant
items.description: "I've been professionally fitted three times in my life. This was the first time someone asked me about my posture before they measured me. The bra fits differently because the conversation was different."

items.title: Yuki, 41 — Forma Night sleep-test participant
items.description: "I didn't expect to notice a difference. But I slept through the night for the first time in months during the trial. I don't know if it's the linen or the lack of elastic pressure. Probably both."

items.title: Chiara, 29 — Forma Soft participant
items.description: "The strap adjustment they made in the second session — I'd never have known to ask for that. But once it was done, I couldn't feel the bra anymore. Which is exactly the point."
